description.zh_cn: 五种方式任选其一即可打开项目，各分支可独立练习。每一步都可以点击“已了解”，不必为了完成演练反复切换项目。实操成功会自动标记；取消或失败不会算作打开成功。
description.en_us: Choose any of five ways to open a project. Explore each branch independently, or acknowledge individual steps without switching projects. Successful operations are detected automatically; cancelled or failed opens are not.

title.zh_cn: 从文件菜单打开文件夹
title.en_us: Open the folder picker from File

body.zh_cn: 点击顶部 **文件 → 打开项目**，唤出文件夹选择器。注意“打开项目目录”是定位当前项目，而不是选择另一个项目。演练窗口可以保持打开，不会阻止操作。
body.en_us: Choose **File → Open Project** to select a folder. The separate Open Project Folder entry reveals the current project instead. This walkthrough can stay open while you work.

title.zh_cn: 选择项目目录并等待就绪
title.en_us: Select a project folder and wait for it to open

body.zh_cn: 选择包含谱面和资源的文件夹并确认。项目就绪后，可在谱面管理中选择要查看的谱面；如果存在未保存修改，请先处理保存提示。
body.en_us: Select the folder containing your beatmaps and resources. Once ready, choose a beatmap in Beatmap Manager. Resolve any unsaved-change prompts first.

title.zh_cn: 按 Ctrl+O 唤出选择器

body.zh_cn: 回到软件窗口，关闭其他模态对话框，然后按 **Ctrl+O**。快捷键会直接打开文件夹选择器，无需展开文件菜单。
body.en_us: Focus the app, close other modal dialogs, and press **Ctrl+O** to open the folder picker directly.

body.zh_cn: 选择项目文件夹并确认。此分支与文件菜单功能相同，但会单独记录快捷键的实操结果。
body.en_us: Select and confirm a project folder. This does the same work as the File menu, but the shortcut branch tracks its own completion.

title.zh_cn: 在系统文件管理器中找到项目文件夹
title.en_us: Find the project folder in your file manager

body.zh_cn: 打开系统文件管理器，找到项目文件夹。每次拖入一个文件夹；不是拖动软件内部的树状目录项。
body.en_us: Locate the project folder in your operating system's file manager. Drag one folder at a time, rather than an item from the app's own tree.

body.zh_cn: 将文件夹拖到软件窗口中松开，包括演练窗口区域。软件会将该目录作为项目打开；有模态对话框时先关闭它。
body.en_us: Drop the folder anywhere inside the app, including this walkthrough. The directory opens as a project. Close modal dialogs before dropping.

title.en_us: Method 4: Drop a beatmap onto the canvas
Locate the beatmap and the canvas

body.zh_cn: 在系统文件管理器中找到 **.mmm / .osu / .mc / .imd** 谱面文件。露出软件中的谱面画布或欢迎画布，不要投放到资源下拉框。
body.en_us: Locate a **.mmm / .osu / .mc / .imd** file. Expose a beatmap canvas or the welcome canvas; do not drop it onto a resource selector.

title.zh_cn: 拖到画布，打开项目并查看谱面
title.en_us: Drop onto the canvas to open and view it

body.zh_cn: 拖到画布后松开。软件先打开谱面所在目录的项目，项目准备完成后再打开这张谱面。只有谱面成功加载到会话，才会自动完成此步骤。
body.en_us: Drop the file onto the canvas. The app opens its containing project first, then loads this beatmap. This step completes automatically only after that beatmap loads successfully.

title.zh_cn: 方式五：临时只读打开谱包
找到 osz / mcz / mpk 谱包
title.en_us: Find an osz / mcz / mpk package

body.zh_cn: 在系统文件管理器中找到 **.osz / .mcz / .mpk** 文件，不需要手动解压。
body.en_us: Locate an **.osz / .mcz / .mpk** file in your file manager. No manual extraction is needed.

title.zh_cn: 拖入软件，以临时只读方式查看
title.en_us: Drop into the app for a temporary read-only preview

body.zh_cn: 将谱包拖入软件窗口。软件解压到临时缓存后以只读项目打开，不会直接修改原始谱包。需要编辑时，先按临时项目提示保存到正式目录。
body.en_us: Drop the package into the app. It is extracted into a temporary cache and opened read-only without modifying the original archive. To edit, first save it to a regular project folder using the temporary-project prompt.
